automation_definition_recurrence_consist.name: automation_definition_recurrence_consistent
automation_definition_recurrence_consist.value: ("automation_definition"."trigger_type" = 'on_creation_once' and "automation_definition"."event_type" is null and "automation_definition"."recurrence_start_at" is null and "automation_definition"."recurrence_every_minutes" is null and "automation_definition"."next_occurrence_at" is null) or ("automation_definition"."trigger_type" = 'recurring_interval' and "automation_definition"."event_type" is null and "automation_definition"."recurrence_start_at" is not null and "automation_definition"."recurrence_every_minutes" between 5 and 10080 and "automation_definition"."next_occurrence_at" is not null) or ("automation_definition"."trigger_type" = 'synthetic_event' and "automation_definition"."event_type" in ('git.pull_request.merged', 'monitor.down', 'monitor.recovered') and "automation_definition"."recurrence_start_at" is null and "automation_definition"."recurrence_every_minutes" is null and "automation_definition"."next_occurrence_at" is null)

automation_run_schedule_matches_trigger.name: automation_run_schedule_matches_trigger
automation_run_schedule_matches_trigger.value: ("automation_run"."trigger" in ('scheduled', 'recurring') and "automation_run"."scheduled_for" is not null and "automation_run"."source_event_id" is null) or ("automation_run"."trigger" in ('on_creation', 'manual') and "automation_run"."scheduled_for" is null and "automation_run"."source_event_id" is null) or ("automation_run"."trigger" = 'synthetic_event' and "automation_run"."scheduled_for" is null and "automation_run"."source_event_id" is not null)

capture_filing_state_valid.name: capture_filing_state_valid
capture_filing_state_valid.value: ("capture"."state" = 'unfiled' and "capture"."filed_at" is null and "capture"."filed_record_kind" is null and "capture"."filed_record_id" is null) or ("capture"."state" = 'filed' and "capture"."filed_at" is not null and "capture"."project_id" is not null and "capture"."filed_record_kind" in ('task', 'note') and "capture"."filed_record_id" is not null)

capture_triage_decision_state_valid.name: capture_triage_decision_state_valid
capture_triage_decision_state_valid.value: ("capture_triage_decision"."decision" = 'reject' and "capture_triage_decision"."selected_project_id" is null and "capture_triage_decision"."selected_kind" is null and "capture_triage_decision"."selected_title" is null and "capture_triage_decision"."selected_body" is null and "capture_triage_decision"."filed_record_id" is null) or ("capture_triage_decision"."decision" = 'approve' and "capture_triage_decision"."selected_project_id" is not null and "capture_triage_decision"."selected_kind" is not null and "capture_triage_decision"."selected_title" is not null and "capture_triage_decision"."selected_body" is not null and "capture_triage_decision"."filed_record_id" is not null)

work_item_planning_event_changed.name: work_item_planning_event_changed
work_item_planning_event_changed.value: ("work_item_planning_event"."previous_priority" is distinct from "work_item_planning_event"."next_priority") or ("work_item_planning_event"."previous_due_on" is distinct from "work_item_planning_event"."next_due_on")

work_item_planning_event_priority_valid.name: work_item_planning_event_priority_valid
work_item_planning_event_priority_valid.value: ("work_item_planning_event"."previous_priority" is null or "work_item_planning_event"."previous_priority" in ('low', 'normal', 'high')) and ("work_item_planning_event"."next_priority" is null or "work_item_planning_event"."next_priority" in ('low', 'normal', 'high'))
